summary: DevRelay is a small deterministic runner for composable software-engineering modules. RequirementsGathering, ArchitectureDesign, and the TraceabilityGraph sidecar are release-ready; WorkBreakdown is now being defined through a normal interactive RequirementsGathering run before ArchitectureDesign and implementation.
stakeholders: Work reviewers and downstream execution systems
domainConstraints: DevRelay Core owns state routing, exact adapter resolution, artifact validation, checkpoints, and progression.
Modules own provider-neutral semantic contracts; adapters own bounded native-tool capabilities.
Adapters never receive TraceabilityGraph and never author graph assertions.
Artifacts and evidence cross boundaries; conversational memory and provider session state do not.
Candidate and approved observations remain distinct; gates own baseline promotion.
The runtime is not a coding agent, model wrapper, marketplace, or distributed scheduler.
conventions: Use exact module and adapter versions with no latest aliases.
Use immutable SHA-256-bound artifact references at runtime boundaries.
Use JSON Schema draft 2020-12 and Ajv validation.
Use lowercase kebab-case module, operation, stage, and port identifiers.
Keep primary outputs provider-neutral and preserve native files as subordinate attachments.
Use underscore-separated machine outcome identifiers within the existing ModuleDefinition contract.
Prove generic behavior with conformance fixtures, negative tests, replay, and Core special-case scans.
